name: Bento: one big, two small
description: One large card on the left carries the main body (a list or a paragraph); two small cards on the right hold supplements or numbers. Three equal cards would lose the weight difference between main and secondary.

title.hint: a one-line claim, up to 24 characters

main.hint: main body: a list of 3 to 5 items, or one paragraph

side-1.hint: supplement one: a short phrase or a big number

side-2.hint: supplement two; leave empty when not needed

brand.value: Confirm the story before the slides

title.value: Two in three layout fixes: reorders

items: Six decks, 24 revision rounds, logged one by one
16 rounds touched layout; 11 of them began as a reorder
Only 5 were real layout faults: tiny type, misplaced figures
Layout churn is a symptom, not the cause

side-1.label: rounds that began as a reorder

side-2.value: Confirm the order first and those 11 rounds never happen.
